summary.text: Lori VanWinkle is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 3 (home city listed as Minot), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for VanWinkle lists an occupation of Real Estate Broker; Realtor, Dakota Realty.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists VanWinkle's standing committee assignments as Government and Veterans Affairs and Judiciary.
